Every candle now fires its own trade. Fable 5.2 called 7 trades, 6 closed green.

this FREE TradingView indicator converts every closed candle into a JSON packet for AI agents. Fable 5.2 picks it up and fires SHORT, LONG or WAIT on its own.

i set up a desk and replayed the last 2 weeks of BTC, ETH and SOL: 19 packets, Fable opened 7 trades, passed 5 times, all 6 that closed came back green at +9.01R

how the indicator works:

> you see candles on a chart. an AI agent cannot
> the indicator converts every closed candle into JSON: regime, trend, momentum, volume, structure, levels, long and short scores out of 100
> Fable 5.2 picks up that packet, decides the trade, and spells out exactly why it could break

how to set it up with Fable 5.2:

1. drop ai-agent-lens.pine from the repo into TradingView's Pine Editor and add it to your chart

2. every closed candle scores a long and a short out of 100, calculated from 5 factors, zero repainting

3. each setup ships with an entry, an ATR stop, and 1.5R / 3R targets plotted on the chart the way TradingView draws its position tool

4. set ONE alert to "any alert function call" and drop in your webhook URL

5. start the webhook receiver from the repo and open a free tunnel

6. every packet drops into packets/latest.json the second the candle closes

7. launch Claude Code with Fable 5.2 and feed it agent/AGENT_PROMPT.md as the prompt

8. pull the signal: you get back the call, confidence, entry, stop, targets, sizing, and the exact reason it could fail

9. one alert per chart. stack BTC, ETH and SOL and have it rank every setup

FREE and open source.

For espionage.

You don't need a laptop.

virals.text:
AI video editing is here

but to do it right you need to give your coding agent all the tooling that it needs to do the middle work of editing

features it must have:

- it needs word by word transcription so it can do accurate cuts

- it needs a GPU Claude so it can render hour long videos in minutes between cuts

- it needs a way for you to get feedback at certain time stamps

- it needs to be able to build motion graphics and render on GPU cloud

- it needs to be able to watch the video it just edited for the mistakes it made using a multi modal model

- multiplayer editing, and sharable link for teams to cowork on the project

so I built this for you

and I open sourced it

because everyone should be able to make content at scale, this is how you win right now

how does it work

- word by word transcription that can do 1 hour of source video in 2 minutes

- speaker diarization so it knows who's talking

- all the editing happens by claude code or grok bot or codex and can add motion graphics etc

- a 1 hour video gets rendered in minutes in the cloud and uploaded to this UI

- this is multiplayer, your team can then mark up the video with comments of feedback

- your coding agent can see that feedback and do the edits

- you can highlight word sections and delete them etc

- you can add features to this by just telling claude code "add this feature"

for a new render after this feedback, re render in minutes

everything it does

- upload every camera angle, the screen recording and each mic as its own file

- it syncs them by matching the audio

- every file gets transcribed on upload, each word tagged with who said it

- tell the agent "make a first cut, 30 seconds, vertical" and it reads the transcripts, picks the takes, cuts the ums and the dead air

- it switches to whoever is talking and cuts to the screen share when they talk about the screen

- crop and zoom on any clip

- comment on a frame or a time range, draw on the video, reply, resolve

- start a comment with @ agent and it becomes a task in the agent's queue

- the agent claims it, makes the edit, renders v2, replies with what it changed and the timecodes

- delete words in the script and playback skips them, cmd z brings them back

- share link so a client can watch and comment with no login

- every version is saved, v1 v2 v3

- export all the notes as markdown or csv

what it's built with

- whisperx for the word level transcript + speaker labels

- ffmpeg for every cut

- modal for the render. the edit gets split into 30 second chunks and they all render at the same time on 4 machines with 64 cores each

- a 48 minute podcast with 5.8 GB of source files rendered in 3 minutes 33 seconds

- chunks are cached so v2 only renders the 30 seconds you changed

- tesseract for the motion graphics

- hls for playback so a 1 hour video starts right away

- postgres for the comments, cuts and versions

- an mcp server with 22 tools so claude code, codex or cursor can drive the whole thing

- node, no framework, about 4,000 lines

- all of it runs on graphed cloud

the edit is just a json file. clips, cameras, mics

the agent writes the json and the cloud turns it into video

get started free here - https://t.co/wZuSwrUfwn

and then just give your agent this skill to start editing -

outsiders.name: Cody Schneider
outsiders.text:
AI video editing is here

but to do it right you need to give your coding agent all the tooling that it needs to do the middle work of editing

features it must have:

- it needs word by word transcription so it can do accurate cuts

- it needs a GPU Claude so it can render hour long videos in minutes between cuts

- it needs a way for you to get feedback at certain time stamps

- it needs to be able to build motion graphics and render on GPU cloud

- it needs to be able to watch the video it just edited for the mistakes it made using a multi modal model

- multiplayer editing, and sharable link for teams to cowork on the project

so I built this for you

and I open sourced it

because everyone should be able to make content at scale, this is how you win right now

how does it work

- word by word transcription that can do 1 hour of source video in 2 minutes

- speaker diarization so it knows who's talking

- all the editing happens by claude code or grok bot or codex and can add motion graphics etc

- a 1 hour video gets rendered in minutes in the cloud and uploaded to this UI

- this is multiplayer, your team can then mark up the video with comments of feedback

- your coding agent can see that feedback and do the edits

- you can highlight word sections and delete them etc

- you can add features to this by just telling claude code "add this feature"

for a new render after this feedback, re render in minutes

everything it does

- upload every camera angle, the screen recording and each mic as its own file

- it syncs them by matching the audio

- every file gets transcribed on upload, each word tagged with who said it

- tell the agent "make a first cut, 30 seconds, vertical" and it reads the transcripts, picks the takes, cuts the ums and the dead air

- it switches to whoever is talking and cuts to the screen share when they talk about the screen

- crop and zoom on any clip

- comment on a frame or a time range, draw on the video, reply, resolve

- start a comment with @ agent and it becomes a task in the agent's queue

- the agent claims it, makes the edit, renders v2, replies with what it changed and the timecodes

- delete words in the script and playback skips them, cmd z brings them back

- share link so a client can watch and comment with no login

- every version is saved, v1 v2 v3

- export all the notes as markdown or csv

what it's built with

- whisperx for the word level transcript + speaker labels

- ffmpeg for every cut

- modal for the render. the edit gets split into 30 second chunks and they all render at the same time on 4 machines with 64 cores each

- a 48 minute podcast with 5.8 GB of source files rendered in 3 minutes 33 seconds

- chunks are cached so v2 only renders the 30 seconds you changed

- tesseract for the motion graphics

- hls for playback so a 1 hour video starts right away

- postgres for the comments, cuts and versions

- an mcp server with 22 tools so claude code, codex or cursor can drive the whole thing

- node, no framework, about 4,000 lines

- all of it runs on graphed cloud

the edit is just a json file. clips, cameras, mics

the agent writes the json and the cloud turns it into video

get started free here - https://t.co/wZuSwrUfwn

and then just give your agent this skill to start editing -
